messages.subject: Executive candidate | Country leadership, government relations and ESG | Qatar and GCC
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Gomez,

I am reaching out following SIGEL's work across workforce, industrial and project environments in Qatar and the Gulf. My background aligns with leadership mandates where government relations, regulatory coordination, ESG, corporate affairs and stakeholder management sit close to commercial and operational delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ years of experience span multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, with current responsibility across ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

I bring direct experience working with ministries, regulators, contractors, communities and senior management around high-consequence operating and investment priorities. My recent work also includes governance support around major solar and battery-storage deployment, carbon-data readiness and institutional coordination.

I am targeting Country Director, Country Representative, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Strategic Partnerships and related leadership mandates across Qatar, the GCC and wider international markets. I am open to expatriate and regional assignments and have a 30-day notice period.

I have attached a focused executive CV and would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
